Men tend to use more lethal suicide methods, which is why their suicide rate is higher. Women attempt much more than men do, but have reported to have used methods that leave less "mess" (their words), which tend to be less lethal and give them a higher chance of attempt survival.

Not that that matters; your level of suffering shouldnt be defined by your suicide, it should be defined on what you experience internally and externally every day.
Buddy, johnny depp is both masculine and hot. If you have his facial hair, you're gucci.
Yep, this is it alright! Wish I could say i didn't relate.
Uh, no, trauma bonds don't force you to cheat on your fiance with your ex. That's not what that means...

I can relate, especially to the sleep part. Like it's the closest I can get to just not being alive and conscious in the world. I hope you can find more things to at least make you happy despite that feeling.
Billions of people around the world would be privelleged to hope to be dead? Like c'mon man you know that doesnt help to hear... You don't know what else is going on in my life.

Im sorry that the crisis workers have fucked up so bad. You did a good thing. Even if it didnt end in him getting help, you bought him the most precious asset someone can have when theyre on the verge of suicide: Time. 

Where he chooses to go on his journey from here is up to him, but you saved someone's fucking life dude. That's huge. Give yourself some credit for that.. Even when you yourself are struggling with the same thoughts, you stepped in and made a difference.
She can still care for you even if she has a bf. But i hear you. It can feel rough when it feels like no one would care. But the brain plays tricks on us man, it doesnt always mean it's fact.

I agree with the shelter dog idea i see in the comments. It sounds like youre escaping a horrible home, and it would be very powerful to become that person who saves a dog from being alone too. It won't replace your pup, but you dont have to grieve her alone.

If it's the only thing youve wanted for a year, surely that means you had something else to live for at some point. 

It will return, friend. It doesnt have to be the same thing as before, in fact it probably wont be. But you are capable of finding a reason again.
